data.content_ref: inline:Total widgets: 24. Total cost: $36. Justification: By direct empirical enumeration of the four observed transactions, each consistently costs $9 and contains 6 widgets. Summing the observed regularities: $9 + $9 + $9 + $9 = $36 and 6 + 6 + 6 + 6 = 24. The totals are the empirical aggregate of four identical transactions.
